instruction.text: Read and listen to the short story.

atoms.text: The cowgirl Tara had a horse called Amy. Tara and Amy rode together everywhere and never stayed too long in one place.
atoms.sound: ssml: The Horse Amy. <break time='1000ms'/> The cowgirl Tara had a horse called Amy. Tara and Amy rode together everywhere and never stayed too long in one place.

atoms.a: Which is an event that has happened?
b: Tara and Amy found a painting.

atoms.text: One day, they were on their way to the next town. Suddenly, Amy whinnied and stood on her hind legs. Then she tried to stomp on something. Tara almost fell off!
atoms.sound: One day, they were on their way to the next town. Suddenly, Amy whinnied and stood on her hind legs. Then she tried to stomp on something. Tara almost fell off!

atoms.a: Which is an event that has happened?

atoms.text:
“Amy! Woah girl! What’s the matter?!” yelled Tara.
Tara trusted Amy. Amy was only scared when there was really something scary. A snake slithered away behind a rock near them. A rattlesnake!
atoms.sound: <voice voice='f1'> Amy! Woah girl! What’s the matter?</voice> yelled Tara. Tara trusted Amy. Amy was only scared when there was really something scary. A snake slithered away behind a rock near them. A rattlesnake!

atoms.text:
Tara turned to Amy, “Clever girl, you saved us from the rattlesnake!”
Amy seemed very proud. She pranced around happily. Tara put extra apples in Amy’s dinner.
